newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Aug 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Aug 13.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - State agency concerned with rural development, the ANADER, is to step up its work. Regional meeting hears that mango production has been a success story for ANADER, and Ivory Coast is now the second biggest exporter after Brazil. - In an interview, U.S. ambassador Lannon Walker says Washington will continue to provide aid to needy countries. Its trade initiative for Africa will supplement the aid effort for deserving countries and encourage economic reforms everywhere. LE JOUR - Union representing 9,000 short-term contract workers facing redundancy from the civil service are to hold a four-day meeting from Thursday to fight the cuts. (1$=630 CFA) -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
